name: BioinformaticsBench
description: BioinformaticsBench is a comprehensive benchmark suite designed to evaluate large language models on reasoning tasks across multiple bioinformatics domains including genetics, genomics, single-cell analysis, proteomics, and metagenomics. It features collegiate-level scientific problems to systematically assess LLM reasoning capabilities in bioinformatics.
reputation: A specialized academic benchmark for bioinformatics reasoning that is useful for research evaluation but is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Curated dataset covering broad bioinformatics domains; includes a detailed user study categorizing LLM errors into ten problem-solving abilities.
